t: Six pairs, each one the same request reversed
a: رَبِّ أَعِنِّي وَلاَ تُعِنْ عَلَىَّ وَانْصُرْنِي وَلاَ تَنْصُرْ عَلَىَّ وَامْكُرْ لِي وَلاَ تَمْكُرْ عَلَىَّ وَاهْدِنِي وَيَسِّرْ هُدَاىَ إِلَىَّ وَانْصُرْنِي عَلَى مَنْ بَغَى عَلَىَّ
p: Rabbi aʿinnī wa lā tuʿin ʿalayy, wa-nṣurnī wa lā tanṣur ʿalayy, wa-mkur lī wa lā tamkur ʿalayy, wa-hdinī wa yassir hudāya ilayy, wa-nṣurnī ʿalā man baghā ʿalayy
m: My Lord, help me and do not help against me. Support me and do not support against me. Plan for me and do not plan against me. Guide me and make my guidance easy for me. And support me against whoever wrongs me.
